summary: Host tools: Jira, Confluence, git_push, GitHub PR/checks/merge
epic_summary: WS-E Integrations (Jira, Confluence, GitHub push/PR/checks/merge, Sonar, intake, web search)
description:
Package `backend/anvil/tools/`. Plain Python functions with type hints + docstrings (they become LangChain tools). Credentials from env, read in the API process only (ADR-004).

## Do

* Jira (REST v3, email + API token): `jira_get(key)`, `jira_comment(key, markdown)`, `jira_transition(key, to_status)`, `jira_set_labels(key, add, remove)`, `jira_create(project, type, summary, description, labels)`, `jira_search(jql)`.
* Confluence (REST v2): `confluence_search(cql)`, `confluence_get(page_id)`, `confluence_write(space_key, title, markdown_or_storage, parent_id=None)`.
* Git: `git_push(sandbox, repo, branch)`: `git bundle create` inside the sandbox -> download -> fetch into a host clone under `%LOCALAPPDATA%/anvil/repos` -> push with the token. Refuse pushes to `main` and to branches not prefixed `anvil/`.
* GitHub (PyGithub or REST): `github_open_pr`, `github_checks(pr)` (waits with timeout), `github_code_scanning_alerts(pr)`, `github_merge(pr, method="squash")` which refuses unless all checks are green.
* Intake poller: JQL `project = RTEMS AND labels = anvil AND statusCategory = "To Do"`.

## Acceptance

* Tests with recorded HTTP (respx/vcrpy cassettes scrubbed of tokens). One live smoke script per service, run by the owner.
